phase: Reference Mode Boundary Review — Sectoral Financial Positions
question: Can the sectoral_financial_positions reference mode be narrowed from the full holder-by-issuer multi-instrument Accounting Spine to directly observed sector-level positions on the same represented F2-F8 instrument boundary, without claiming bilateral accounting completion?
rationale: Reference modes are behaviour-over-time targets and need not be identical to the model's complete bilateral state representation.
The Dynamic Core already defines sector_financial_assets, sector_financial_liabilities and sector_net_financial_worth as aggregate auxiliaries derived from bilateral positions.

ECB QSA directly publishes sector-level asset/liability stocks and financial transactions by ESA financial instrument. The RMD aggregate can therefore be built explicitly as F2+F3+F4+F5+F6+F7+F8, avoiding any reliance on an unpublished or structurally assumed F1 zero.
The RMD financial-corporation sector is definitionally S12 minus S121, preserving BNR as a separate S121 sector. H maps to S1M, C to S11 and G to S13.

The rest-of-world sector X can be represented from W1 external positions by reversing the resident external asset/liability orientation: X assets equal resident external liabilities and X liabilities equal resident external assets.

Observed aggregate sector positions can validate aggregate behaviour-over-time while the bilateral Accounting Spine remains incomplete. They must never be used to allocate counterparties or initialize unresolved bilateral cells.

proposed_reference_boundary.source_aggregate_identity: RMD represented financial boundary = explicit sum of QSA F2+F3+F4+F5+F6+F7+F8.
proposed_reference_boundary.X_mapping: Use W1 total-economy external positions. RMD X assets = resident W1 liabilities; RMD X liabilities = resident W1 assets, after applying the same F minus F1 boundary.

separation_from_accounting_spine.rule: Promotion of the aggregate reference mode, if its source gate passes, changes only behaviour-over-time observability. It cannot be cited as evidence that F2/F4/F5/F6/F7/F8 bilateral matrices are complete.

preregistration_requirements: Exact QSA series-key construction and sector mapping must be frozen before the live audit.

Both stock (LE) and financial-transaction (F) series must be available for every represented instrument F2-F8 needed by each sector-side construction; no unavailable instrument may be converted to zero.
All six RMD sectors must be finite for every required benchmark period.
F = S12 - S121 must be evaluated from exact same-period source values, never from shares.
X orientation must pass the represented-system conservation/reconciliation check.
No missing-to-zero, interpolation or graphical reconstruction is allowed.
A successful source vintage must be retained with hashes before promotion.
Behavioural closure and Accounting Spine readiness must remain unchanged.
